### What Unit Managers Deliver
- Assign a test submission to **each** Principal/Senior Officer in their unit — everyone gets hands-on practice, not just the manager
- Allocate pilot submissions for checklist review and assessment
- Complete checklist review and assessment for every pilot case assigned to their unit
- Sign off and hand back completed pilot cases so they progress to Secretary review
:::
::: {.col}
### What to Review
- Does the unit's digitized checklist match the real requirements for that form type?
- Is document upload and required-document matching working correctly?
- Turnaround time against expected SLA
- Any confusing steps or workflow gaps to flag
:::
:::

::: {.feedback}
<b>Feedback:</b> report issues immediately so they're fixed before full ministry rollout.
:::
